# virtio_rng.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

A vulnerable kernel driver that can be used to disable Code Integrity
- **UUID**: 1757aa0e-0e7c-477a-b224-a73ce07b9e3b
- **Created**: 2026-10-25
- **Author**: Andrea Monzani
- **Acknowledgement**: Andrea Monzani, Davide Netti, Antonio Parata | [](https://twitter.com/)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/90efcd59ca7522d9733d1493589a2676.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "virtio_rng.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create virtio_rng binPath=C:\windows\temp\virtio_rng.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start virtio_rng
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
